idea-plugin.name: NuGet README Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Read NuGet.org package documentation before installing a package.

Open View | Tool Windows | NuGet README, search for a package and choose a version. Preview Markdown, copy examples, and open documentation links in your browser.

This independent tool window does not modify your projects or install packages. Supports public NuGet.org only. Remote images and embedded HTML are restricted for safety.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial preview: package search, version selection, safe README rendering and bounded memory caching.
